value.title: Phase 1: Knob to screen over BLE
value.summary: Prove BLE, port the decoder test-first, show the knob on screen.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom. Hardware smoke steps that take the knob from the Mac or touch the amp wait for Vaughan's go-ahead.

value.title: Spike: throwaway NimBLE-Arduino sketch in /tmp/bluos-ble-spike bonds to ANTICATER_MINI and prints raw Report notifications, while Wi-Fi is connected with periodic HTTP GETs and M5Unified redraws the screen
value.success: Go/no-go verdict, payload form, bonding quirks and min free heap under BLE+Wi-Fi+display recorded in the execution log; spike code discarded
value.note: Superseded: the real NimBLE adapter (tk-2105) bonded on first attempt, so no throwaway spike was needed. Coexistence proof moved to tk-2207.
value.receipt: 17:07:31 knob connected ANTICATER_MINI ee:aa:b8:d6:82:5e reports:6; payload form = report-id-less 2 bytes (e900/ea00/e200/6f00/7000)

value.title: Scaffold firmware/ PlatformIO project (espressif32 Arduino + M5Unified + NimBLE-Arduino; envs m5stick and native) and justfile fw-build/fw-test/fw-flash/fw-monitor via uvx
value.success: `just fw-build` succeeds; `just fw-test` runs (empty) native suite; .pio ignored
value.note: Unblocked via brew install platformio (Vaughan approved).
value.receipt: just fw-build SUCCESS (RAM 12.9%, Flash 61.0%); just fw-test 5/5; firmware/.gitignore ignores .pio

value.title: RED: native tests for knob_core decoder with Test Doc blocks: real capture vectors (03e900 … 030000), report-id-less forms, unknown usage
value.success: Tests compile and fail for the missing decoder
value.receipt: just fw-test (stub decoder): 4 failed / 1 passed on assertions (RED)

value.title: GREEN: implement knob_core decoder (16-bit LE usage scan + release rule, same table as normalizer.py)
value.receipt: just fw-test: 5/5 passed; table = normalizer.py CONSUMER_USAGE_TO_ACTION (0xE9,0xEA,0xE2,0x6F,0x70) + same release rule

value.title: BLE knob adapter: scan for ANTICATER name, bond, subscribe to HID reports, enqueue timestamped raw payloads to a bounded FreeRTOS queue (drop-newest on overflow, counted); reconnect with backoff; serial `bonds clear`
value.success: Adapter compiles; callback does no work beyond enqueue; overflow is counted, never blocks
value.receipt: on_report only copies+xQueueSend(…,0), overflow counted (status.dropped=0 over 42 events); just fw-build SUCCESS; bonded + reconnects:1

value.title: Screen v1 + serial log: board name at boot, knob link state, last action + counter; one JSON-ish action line per event on serial
value.success: Renders on the detected M5 model
value.receipt: Boot line board=StickC+; Vaughan: "i can see it's working on the device now"; serial action line {seq,action,raw,usage,t_ms} emitted in main.cpp handle_event

value.title: Hardware smoke (Vaughan's go-ahead: unpairs knob from Mac): flash, bond, every gesture shows on screen + serial; knob power-cycle reconnects
value.success: Recorded in execution log with serial excerpts

tk-2101.assertion: Serial shows raw notification bytes for turn up/down and press
No missed gestures across 50 turns with Wi-Fi + display active; min free heap logged
tk-2101.note: Moved: BLE+Wi-Fi+display coexistence is proven in tk-2207 (Wi-Fi does not exist until Phase 2).

tk-2101.assertion: Verdict + constraints written to execution log

tk-2103.assertion: just fw-test fails on decoder assertions before implementation

tk-2106.assertion: Boot screen shows detected board name
Action line format documented in code

tk-2107.assertion: Each of up/down/mute/brightness± seen on screen
